frozen_reference_note: Observed river fluxes differ from the simplified near-steady analytical conductance reference by less than 4.3e-5 m3/day and satisfy the preregistered 0.01 m3/day tolerance. The actual product observations are internally reciprocal at reported precision.
qualified_claims: At every product-step start, RibaMod applies the accepted Ribasim subgrid level as the active MF6 River stage.
The positive MF6 River flux is transferred back to Ribasim as positive Basin infiltration at the same reported rate.
Ribasim drainage remains zero throughout the experiment.
The accepted Basin level decreases monotonically, and each next product step uses that newly accepted level as its MF6 River stage.
Cumulative Ribasim infiltration equals Basin storage loss within numerical precision at every accepted boundary.
The actual product driver therefore implements a reciprocal staggered active-river bridge: accepted Ribasim stage -> MF6 solve -> exchange flux -> next Ribasim physical state.
boundaries: This qualifies sample-and-hold/staggered product reciprocity, not implicit same-window coupled convergence.
No management/UserDemand is present in this work unit.
downstream: Combine the qualified active-river physical bridge with management only in a separately preregistered work unit.
